_doc: A-ui-r1 stint 1: findings 8 (warn disabled) + 11 (Look at it frames the tower, card to pill). Run: setsid nohup _harness/slot.sh node _harness/shots.mjs _harness/arc-work/specs/ui-r1.json --port=5311 > _harness/scratch/arc/ui-r1/shots.log 2>&1 &

shots.name: ur1-card
script: window.__toChoice = async () => { let tw = null, d = 0; for (d = 0; d < 60; d++) { await G.step(720); const ts = (await G.arc.towers()) ?? []; tw = ts.find((t) => t.choiceOpen) ?? null; if (tw) break; } window.__tw = tw; return d; };

const d = await window.__toChoice(); await G.frames(3); const R = (q) => { const r = document.querySelector(q)?.getBoundingClientRect(); return r ? [r.left, r.top, r.width, r.height].map(Math.round) : null; };

return { halfDays: d, tw: window.__tw && { name: window.__tw.name, h: window.__tw.height, goal: window.__tw.goal, league: window.__tw.league, builders: window.__tw.builders }, dec: G.arc.decision(), card: R('.gn-decision'), text: document.querySelector('.gn-decision')?.innerText, toasts: [...document.querySelectorAll('.gn-toast')].map((t) => t.innerText).slice(0,6) };

shots.name: ur1-look
script: G.hold(false); const b = [...document.querySelectorAll(".gn-decision button")].find((x) => x.textContent.includes("Look")); b?.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2500)); await G.frames(6); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); await G.frames(4); G.hold("ui");
const R = (q) => { const r = document.querySelector(q)?.getBoundingClientRect(); return r && r.width ? [r.left, r.top, r.width, r.height].map(Math.round) : null; };

return { clicked: !!b, speed: G.view?.speed, dec: G.arc.decision(), card: R(".gn-decision:not([hidden])"), pill: R(".gn-decision-pill"), tw: window.__tw && { h: window.__tw.height, pos: window.__tw.pos } };

shots.name: ur1-warn-card
script: let tw = null, d = 0; for (d = 0; d < 60; d++) { await G.step(720); const ts = (await G.arc.towers()) ?? []; tw = ts.find((t) => t.choiceOpen) ?? null; if (tw) break; } window.__tw = tw; await G.frames(3);

const pv = window.__GENESIS_FX__.fx.vis.pv; const A = pv.agents; let pick = null; for (let i = 0; i < A.count && !pick; i++) { const bio = await G.query('agent', { id: A.id[i] }); if (bio && bio.age >= 25 && bio.settlement && tw.league.includes(bio.settlement.id)) pick = bio; }
const ff = pick ? await G.freeform('make ' + pick.name + ' my prophet') : null; await G.step(10); await G.frames(3);

return { d, pick: pick && { name: pick.name, st: pick.settlement.id, age: pick.age }, ff: JSON.stringify(ff).slice(0, 300), dec1, txt1, dec2: G.arc.decision(), txt2: document.querySelector('.gn-decision')?.innerText };

shots.name: ur1-warn-after
script: if (!G.arc.decision().open) { const p = document.querySelector('.gn-decision-pill'); p?.click(); await G.frames(3); }

const r = await G.arc.choose('3'); await G.step(1440*2); G.hold(false); const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.gn-btn')].find((x) => x.textContent.includes('Look')); await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', target: { kind: 'settlement', id: window.__tw.host }, dist: 900, tilt: 55, yaw: 20, fov: 50, hour: 11 }); await G.frames(3); G.hold('ui');

shots.name: ur1-warn-day6
script: await G.step(1440*5); G.hold(false); await G.frames(3); G.hold('ui');

const p = document.querySelector(".gn-decision-pill"); if (!G.arc.decision().open) { p?.click(); await G.frames(3); } return { towers: JSON.stringify(await G.arc.towers()).slice(0,700), dec: G.arc.decision(), text: document.querySelector(".gn-decision")?.innerText, press: JSON.stringify(await G.arc.choose("3")).slice(0,200) };
